subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: You've been tracking meals for 3 weeks but missing the single most powerful predictor of success. The truth inside.
body_paragraphs: I was looking at your progress. The meal logs are solid. The weight tracking is there. But something's missing. It's the same thing I missed with my own dog, Charlie, for the first month. And it's why his progress plateaued.

Here's the confession: tracking food is only half the battle. The other half is invisible to most owners. It's the silent factor that determines whether your dog's metabolism is burning or storing. I thought calories were king until my vet showed me the data. The real secret isn't just what you feed, but *when* you feed it and what you pair it with. This changes everything about weight loss.

You've had the tool for this the whole time. It's the 'Meal Timing & Nutrient Pairing' guide buried in the 'Advanced Plan' section. Most people see 'advanced' and skip it. But it's not complicated—it's just the truth most pet food companies don't want you to know. It shows you how to schedule meals and combine foods to keep their energy stable and fat burning constant.

Open the app. Tap 'Advanced Plan' at the bottom of the home screen. Scroll to 'Meal Timing & Pairing'. Read the 2-minute guide. Then adjust just one meal tomorrow. You'll see the difference in their energy by the afternoon. P.S. The dogs who use this feature hit their goal weight 30% faster. Don't let Charlie's early mistake be yours.
